results.title: Manager, Micro Mobility Operations
results.description: Redefining Land, Air, and Sea Travel… Elevating Destinations. Coastal Transportation Services Co., a Red Sea Global Subsidiary Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides Transportation services at our Red Sea destination and is part of the Red Sea Global Group of companies. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. As a subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Co. benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group of companies, enhancing our ability to serve our clients effectively. Are you ready to transform the future of transportation? At Coastal Transportation Services Co., we are driven by innovation, creativity, and a passion for redefining transportation. Our team is shaping the future with cutting-edge projects, from autonomous vehicles to sustainable transportation solutions. We are seeking forward-thinking individuals eager to collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where ideas become reality. Join us in revolutionizing transportation and creating a smarter, more sustainable world—one innovation at a time. Join our visionary team and help shape the future of transportation! Job Purpose: To lead the operational planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of micro mobility services across the organization’s properties. This role is responsible for ensuring seamless delivery of buggy, e-bike, and other micro mobility solutions, supporting the wider Mobility strategy. The position holds accountability for service delivery, stakeholder engagement, team leadership and operational efficiency in a 24/7 environment. Key Responsibilities: Service Operations Leadership Manage daily micro mobility operations across multiple service types and locations. Ensure service continuity, timely asset availability and operational resilience. Support integration of new modes (e.g., e-bikes, scooters) as part of service expansion. Team and Resource Management Lead supervisory staff, operators, and support teams across the micro mobility network. Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned with safety and customer service. Oversee training, onboarding, and staff scheduling to meet service requirements. Performance and Compliance Oversight Ensure all services operate within regulatory, safety and policy frameworks. Monitor service metrics and deliver improvement plans to enhance efficiency and user satisfaction. Implement incident management protocols and ensure timely resolution of issues. Stakeholder Engagement Act as key point of contact for operational queries, escalations, and service coordination. Work cross-functionally with departments including Land Operations, TOCC, Maintenance and Projects. Liaise with vendors and partners to support service delivery and infrastructure readiness. Planning and Development Support service expansion through structured operational plans and asset deployment strategies. Drive forward innovation and technology adoption within micro mobility operations. Assist in the development of SOPs, risk assessments and operational documentation. Reporting and Communication Provide regular operational updates, service performance reports and improvement proposals. Ensure consistent communication across teams and with leadership. Profile Requirements Experience in operations or transport leadership, preferably within micro mobility or fleet services. Proven ability to manage teams in fast-paced, high-visibility environments. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and resolve challenges quickly. Operational mindset with the ability to lead services at both strategic and frontline levels. Adaptable and resourceful, with a commitment to service excellence.

results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 25+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Fleet Incharge - Saudi Nationals
results.description: Key Responsibilities Fleet Operations Management Manage the daily deployment and scheduling of heavy vehicles to ensure maximum fleet utilization. Assign transport requests to drivers based on location, cargo type, driver availability, and working hours. Optimize vehicle routing to minimize empty kilometers and improve operational efficiency. Monitor fleet movements in real-time using GPS tracking systems such as Wialon, Geotab, and WhatsGPS . Respond promptly to operational disruptions including breakdowns, delays, road closures, and checkpoint issues. Ensure transport services meet project schedules and customer requirements. Fleet Performance & Cost Control Monitor daily fuel consumption using FLS fuel monitoring systems and investigate fuel deviations. Analyze operational data to improve fuel efficiency and reduce transportation costs. Track fleet utilization, cost per kilometer, idle time, and empty mileage. Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules based on mileage and manufacturer recommendations. Monitor tire performance, oil changes, filters, and other maintenance requirements to minimize unplanned downtime. Work closely with maintenance teams to ensure vehicle availability and reliability. Driver Management Supervise a large team of drivers and ensure sufficient manpower coverage across all operations. Prepare driver rosters, shift schedules, and leave plans to maintain uninterrupted fleet operations. Monitor driver productivity and evaluate performance using key performance indicators. Conduct driver inductions and training on: Company policies Fleet tracking systems Safe driving practices Eco-driving techniques Regulatory compliance Investigate traffic violations, accidents, and incidents, implementing corrective and preventive actions. Compliance & Documentation Ensure all fleet documentation remains valid, including: Vehicle registrations Insurance MVPI certificates Operating cards Driver licenses Generate transport documentation through the Naql Platform . Monitor cargo manifests using the Bayan System . Maintain accurate records for: Fuel invoices Maintenance records Weighbridge tickets Fleet operational reports Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports covering fleet performance, utilization, costs, maintenance, and operational issues. Operational Reporting & KPI Management Monitor and report on fleet performance against established KPIs. Analyze operational trends and recommend improvements to increase productivity and reduce operating costs. Prepare management reports on: Fleet utilization Fuel efficiency On-time delivery Maintenance performance Driver performance Cost analysis Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with company HSE policies and transportation regulations. Monitor adherence to TGA working and rest-hour regulations. Promote a strong safety culture among drivers and fleet personnel. Ensure cargo is transported safely while protecting company assets and customer property. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Fleet Utilization Rate Average Fuel Consumption Cost per Kilometer On-Time Delivery Performance Empty Kilometer Percentage Preventive Maintenance Compliance Vehicle Downtime Driver Safety Performance Accident & Traffic Violation Rate (Target: Zero Major Accidents) Driver Productivity Operational Cost Reduction Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Additional certifications in Fleet Management or Logistics are advantageous. Experience Minimum 7 years of experience in fleet or transportation operations. At least 3–5 years managing heavy commercial vehicle fleets . Experience handling fleets supporting industrial projects, shutdowns, turnaround projects, or large-scale logistics operations. Experience managing fleets of 500+ heavy vehicles and supervising 700+ drivers is highly preferred.

results.title: Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility
results.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility to lead the establishment, commercialization, and scaling of a new autonomous mobility business in the region. This is a high-impact business leadership role with end-to-end accountability for strategy, P&L, commercialization, regulatory engagement, strategic partnerships, operations, and organizational development. Qualifications MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Logistics, Technology, Mobility, or a related discipline. 10–15 years of relevant experience in mobility, logistics, CEP, autonomous vehicles, smart mobility, or adjacent technology-enabled sectors. Significant experience in the UAE or GCC is strongly preferred. Proven track record of launching, scaling, and commercializing new businesses, products, or technology-enabled services. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong commercial track record. Experience working in startup, venture-building, transformation, or high-growth environments. Strong experience engaging with government and regulatory stakeholders. Experience with public-private partnerships or government-led innovation programs is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of the mobility and CEP sectors, including smart cities, urban logistics, last-mile delivery economics, and operating models. Practical understanding of autonomous vehicle technologies, deployment models, safety requirements, and operational considerations. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the business strategy for autonomous mobility, aligned with the organization’s growth and innovation agenda. Develop scalable commercial models for autonomous mobility solutions across public roads, campuses, private developments, and other relevant environments. Own the business P&L, including revenue growth, cost management, investment planning, and overall financial performance. Lead go-to-market strategy, pricing, customer acquisition, commercial pipeline development, and strategic partnerships. Develop and execute autonomous vehicle deployment programs from business case and pilot through to commercial scale. Lead engagement with UAE regulatory and government authorities to secure approvals and enable compliant operations. The role will be responsible for monitoring fleet performance, coordinating trucks and drivers, analyzing logistics costs, Sales invoices , maintaining accurate records, and supporting efficient delivery operations. Coordinate with Warehouse, Sales, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries. Monitor driver attendance, trips, working hours, and performance. Maintain accurate fleet, driver, vehicle, and delivery records. Track fuel consumption, maintenance, repair costs, and other fleet-related expenses. results.title: Director of Operations - Saudi Arabia AOC (GACA)
results.description: Beond is the world's first premium leisure airline, flying an all-lie-flat Airbus fleet, and is standing up new Air Operator Certificates in Bahrain (BCAA) and Saudi Arabia (GACA). We are seeking a Director of Operations for our Saudi Arabia AOC (General Authority of Civil Aviation), based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Director of Operations is appointed by, and reports to, the Accountable Executive, and is responsible for: Exercise operational control and accountability for the conduct of flight operations under the AOC Own the operations manual, ensure ops-specifications compliance and set operational standards Oversee flight dispatch, flight-time limitations and flight-crew standards Serve as the operational interface with GACA for approvals, audits and findings Embed the SMS within operations Requirements This is a required management position under GACAR Part 121.45. The post is full-time and the successful candidate must be acceptable to GACA (the President) based on experience, competence and knowledge, with a full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)). Mandatory Hold an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate (GACAR 121.49(a)(1)) At least 3 years' supervisory/managerial experience within the last 6 years exercising operational control over Part 121-similar operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(2)) At least 3 years' experience within the past 6 years as PIC of a Part 121 aircraft — for a first-time Director of Operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(3)) Full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual; must be acceptable to GACA (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)) Desirable Airbus A320/A321 experience Existing GACA regulatory relationships and new-AOC experience Fluent English; Arabic advantageous Benefits A competitive package with relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to build a premium airline certificate from the ground up as part of a fast-growing multi-AOC group. If you do not receive a response from us within 4 weeks of submitting your application, please consider your application to be unsuccessful due to the high volume of applications we receive.

In this role you will get to lead and manage all technical and operational interfaces between multiple parties while planning and controlling logistics to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of major infrastructure works. Position Overview: The Interface & Logistics Manager will lead and manage all technical and operational interfaces between multiple contractors, consultants, stakeholders, and authorities on the project, while planning and controlling logistics to ensure safe, efficient and timely delivery of works. The role is a key part of Parsons’ PMC team, acting as a central coordination point to avoid scope gaps, conflicts and delays across all packages. Working with contractors to plan and schedule material deliveries, heavy transport, and critical lifts, ensuring compliance with local authority regulations and project HSSE requirements. Monitoring and managing logistics KPIs (delivery performance, congestion, utilization, etc.) using PMIS and other tools and proposing corrective actions where needed. Ensuring integration of logistics plans with interface constraints, utility diversions, and phased handovers, particularly in live or sensitive operational environments. Supporting approvals and permits related to interfaces and logistics (road closures, diversions, utility connections, working windows, etc.). Ensuring clear communication of interface requirements to all stakeholders, including constraints affecting operations, safety, and public impact. PMIS, Reporting & Documentation Maintaining interface and logistics data in the project PMIS (e.g. Aconex or equivalent), ensuring accurate and up-to-date records, action tracking, and document control. Preparing periodic interface and logistics status reports, dashboards, and KPIs for Parsons PMC and client management. Recording, maintaining, and updating interface agreements, minutes of meetings, decisions, and approvals to ensure traceability and auditability. HSSE & Compliance Ensuring all interface and logistics activities comply with project HSSE requirements, local regulations, and Parsons PMC procedures. Identifying and helping mitigate interface-related HSSE risks (e.g. conflicting work fronts, traffic management, simultaneous operations, live utilities). Promoting a proactive safety culture among contractors in relation to logistics, access, and interfaces. Fluency in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.
